text:
maya (Marketing): Quick sync 1
Need a tight latency vs cost benchmark brief for launch. Thinking 3 mini-visuals: median+p95 latency by model, $/1k tokens across quant+batch, and throughput vs monthly cost for 3 app archetypes. Which should be hero for landing/tweet/webinar?

sam (Data Viz): 3-panel is solid. Chart 1: median line + p95 shaded. Chart 2: log y for cost. Chart 3: area for throughput vs cost by archetype.

owen (Growth): Add one-sentence KPI card for socials: "$0.XX /1k tokens at 90ms median". CTA split: cost -> PLG signup, sla -> enterprise form, webinar -> nurture.

tara (Content): Hero copy draft: "Predictable latency. Lower unit cost." Subhead: "Benchmarks across realistic configs — pick the latency or price point that fits your product."

maya (Marketing): Good. Need PLG vs enterprise messaging variants and UTMs for routing.

bench-bot: bench-run-complete: 2026-03-20. CSV link: s3://bench/2026-03-20/summary.csv (median_latency_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_sec,usd_per_1k_tokens).

sam (Data Viz): Will pull sample rows and drop figma frames by Wed. Include a 1-line reproducibility caption under each viz listing model and config.

tara (Content): Webinar plan: 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Title options: "Latency-first inference: SLAs without the sticker shock" or "Serve LLMs reliably at lower unit cost." Tone: start technical -> product examples.

owen (Growth): Routing sketch (UTM tags): cost-cta -> /signup?utm=bench_cost, sla-cta -> /enterprise/interest?utm=bench_sla, webinar -> /webinar?utm=bench_webinar. I'll wire HubSpot lists.

maya (Marketing): Timeline: visuals Wed EOD, copy Thurs, landing live Fri AM, promo next week. Blockers?

sam (Data Viz): None.

owen (Growth): I'll prep routing and form IDs.

tara (Content): I'll draft 3 email subject variants for A/B test and social thread (3 tweets: KPI, explainer, link).

maya (Marketing): One short FAQ blurb on quantization for non-ML readers please.

sam (Data Viz): FAQ draft: "Quantization reduces memory and cost by lowering numeric precision. Most chat workloads are fine at 8-bit; 4-bit needs validation on your prompt set."

maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll assemble a 1-page brief and drop in #design-ops. :thumbsup:
